name: touchstone
description: A verification gate for coding agents — it refuses "done" when the evidence says otherwise.

plugins.name: touchstone
plugins.description: One C++ binary on the Stop hook. It reads the transcript of the turn trying to finish and blocks when a check failed, a stub was introduced, or a substantial code change shipped with no verification. Budgeted blocks, fail-open everywhere, benchmarked in CI at 11/11 caught and 0 false positives. No dependencies.
